dataset.source: CICIDS2017 sample (Kaggle: sweety18/cicids2017-full-dataset), prepared by ml_factory/prepare_cicids.py

holdout_policy: holdout is not mounted in any experiment; scored exactly once, by Evaluation, at campaign close

metric.definition: binary F1 on the positive class, recomputed by Evaluation from raw predictions; campaign metric is the mean over >= 3 seeds
metric.name: f1

rate_card.note: local CPU sandbox, priced nominally so compute burn is visible in the same units as wages
